body: Can confirm this happens in 4.8 beta1. This happens because `EditorProperty::shortcut_input` gets called when doing this and it uses`EditorContextMenuPluginManager::get_singleton()` which returns nullptr.

Bisected to PR #118585. CC @KoBeWi
